account: Barnsley reports that its expanded Microsoft Copilot deployment saves staff time in transcription, summaries, administration, procurement, legal work, and finance. Regular use is reported at 70%. Financial returns are still being evaluated. The council had issued Copilot licenses across the organization by the first week of January 2024. On 1 February 2026, the Local Democracy Reporting Service reported that the council would keep funding the licenses at £300,000 a year and that its cabinet report said that £1m in savings from the Microsoft program had still to be delivered.
